description: Precommitted deterministic plateau-boundary probe. WIP attacks with 700 T6 Marksmen and no heroes; minxxx defends with 6 T6 Infantry and 700 T6 Lancers and no heroes. Using the supplied 2dp stats plus minxxx's stated hidden +2pp Attack/Defense, the simulator predicts minxxx wins with exactly 478 Lancers. Counts 6 and 7 are the same lower plateau because the Infantry line is exhausted in round 1. The boundary is predicted between 7 and 8 Infantry.
